title: Neutonic’s $25M Brand Strategy 👁️
transcript: Newtonic is on pace to do over $25 million this year and most people still do not understand their actual funnel. They're now in over 10000+ retail locations. But retail is not the strategy. Distribution is. They're running ads, pushing Amazon Subscribe and save. Retail stores repeat purchases because the goal is not just getting someone to try the drink once, it's getting the drink into the consumers daily routine. This is where real CBG scale happens. Most brands focus on acquisition. Newtonic is focused on frequency. More touch points, more availability, more repeat consumption. This is how you build a modern beverage brand in 2026. Comment CBG and I'll send you the five stages you must go through to scale.
